verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm whose core product is legal counsel (formation, financing, IP, privacy and other practice areas), so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product. Its LathamDrive web tools, glossary apps and document generators are hosted resources, and nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable software distribution that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
